title: Tool Room Engineer/Senior Engineer
description:
Role & responsibilities We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Tool Room Engineer with 6 to 7 years of hands-on expertise in mold design, precision machining, and tool room operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for end-to-end plastic injection mold design, Managing machining operations (VMC, EDM, Wire Cut, Laser Welding) Executing preventive maintenance, leading breakdown repairs, and implementing Engineering Change Notes (ECN).

Key Skills: Wire,VMC,Machine,Cut,EDM,Laser,Senior,Laser welding
